name: Financius, the Moneyrender
description:
Halve all damage dealt with Financius, the Moneyrender.

Once per day, you may spend 10 minutes sharpening the blade with gold worth 1 Treasure. The gold melds with the blade, filling notches and forming a sharp edge. This process imbues the sword with 3 charges. Any time you deal damage with Financius, the Moneyrender and it has charges, remove 1 charge and double the damage instead of halving it.

improvements.name: Golden Edge
improvements.description: Each time you apply gold to the blade as defined above, you may instead apply 3 Treasure's worth of gold. If you do, Financius, the Moneyrender deals double damage for the next day.
